Investment Surge in India's Data Center Sector

Global investment is pouring into India's data center sector, with EQT reportedly planning a $50 billion push, partly through a bet on Adani data centers, to capitalize on the nation's AI boom. Separately, an Indian project financier has provided over $1.2 billion in loans for data center projects. The Wire suggests this $300 billion data center boom could benefit youth in Tier-2 cities. Meanwhile, international coverage notes that the AI data center boom is encountering local resistance in Silicon Valley.
